title: HB1587 (113th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 4; Title 38; Title 39; Title 40; Title 47 and Title 68, relative to firearms.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Draft, 2024-02-14; official copy via LegiScan getBillText doc 2928121)
provenance.note: Draft as filed (version dated 2024-02-14); summary says 'As introduced' and no passage vote is recorded, so no amendments are missing. Caption lists Titles 4, 38, 40, 47 and 68, but the text read contains only the Title 39 section.

operative_text: SECTION 1 (new TCA section in Title 39, Chapter 17, Part 13): (b) It is an offense to knowingly manufacture a semi-automatic rifle in this state. (c) A violation of subsection (b) is a Class A misdemeanor.
